pain_point: Want to own not rent for retirement - I want to own the property so when I retire I can lease it out as passive income
headline_outcome: Own a Warehouse. Retire on It.
primary_text: "I want to own the property so when I retire I can lease it out as passive income." Talk to any retired tradie or business owner who bought their warehouse 15 years ago. They'll tell you it was the single best financial decision they ever made. Not the ute. Not the tools. The property. These new Truganina warehouses are purpose-built for owner-occupiers on the Princes Freeway corridor — high demand for industrial tenants, strong rental yields, and growing capital values. Buy it off-the-plan now while prices are accessible. Use it for your business. Pay it off. Retire with an income-producing asset that works while you don't.
description: Experienced business owners say buying their warehouse was their best financial decision
